title: SQL Server databases
description: Let the assistant look things up in a Microsoft SQL Server database. Ask your IT team for a read-only SQL login.
perPerson: Only you can see and use your connections. The password stays on the server.
driverMissing: SQL Server support is not installed on this server yet; ask the owner to update.
name: Name
passwordKept: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
allowWrites: Allow changes (each change asks you first)
removeBody: The assistant can no longer query this database. The database itself is not changed.
errRequired: Fill in the name, server, database and SQL login.
errName: Names use letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores (up to 64).
errPort: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
